$comment: site.footer.columns holds one column with no title: a single flat menu, as WordPress has (SC-006). Its list takes the nav's name as its aria-label (SC-019). site.logo.light names a media id; no dark logo is set, so the link carries no data-swaps. site.logoHeight 40 decides the logo's sizes; the height itself is the site stylesheet's --logo-height, never in the markup (SC-029).
summary: A single flat menu as one untitled column, on the surface-inverse tone, with the light logo in the brand block, and the copyright line; no socials, and no consent control, as no consent mechanism is wired (SC-030).
